ai.summary: The page https://www.givedirectly.org/ loaded in a headless browser with HTTP 200 and no load error. The FundraiseUp installation code was not found in the page source, and no FundraiseUp widget request was recorded. The verdict is not installed, because the installation code is missing. Google Tag Manager (GTM-PJNMMGH), GA4 (G-GV8XF9FJ16), and Meta Pixel (1507191883453125) were found and loaded. No other donation tool was found on the page. No known cookie consent tool was detected. The page load event was at 3.8 s. The browser recorded 6 console errors, including Content Security Policy errors for inline scripts. The browser did not click any buttons, so checkout and donate behavior was not tested. No checkout form links were found.

customer_email.subject: Next steps to install donation tools on givedirectly.org
customer_email.body:
Hello,

Thank you for working with us to launch donations on your website. We checked https://www.givedirectly.org/ and the page loads correctly. The donation platform code is not on the page yet.

Please do the following:

1. Add the FundraiseUp installation code to the page source on https://www.givedirectly.org/. We will send the code to you separately.
2. Check the Content Security Policy on the site so the donation script is allowed to run. The page currently shows errors about inline scripts being blocked.
3. Set up a cookie consent tool for visitors in the EU and UK, if this applies to you.

Once the code is in place, please let us know and we will run the check again.

Thank you,
The Onboarding Team
